notes: Asking price is inside div.price > h2. Revenue and Cash Flow appear as inline text spans inside div.price-revenue-flow with consistent labels 'Revenue:' and 'Cash Flow:'. City is never shown on any of the three pages; location is only described at a region or state level (e.g. 'Connecticut', 'Long Island', 'The South') within the body text, not in a structured field. State is similarly not disclosed in a structured field on any page.
